messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find the dataset titled Tweetplomacy 23 – An Annotated Collection of Tweets Outlining Strategies of Political Risk Communication during Global Crises (2018-2023)?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: "Tweetplomacy 23" dataset annotated collection tweets political risk communication
action.query: "Tweetplomacy 23" dataset annotated collection tweets political risk communication

This dataset is published by the GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences and contains semantically annotated tweets documenting political risk communication during three major global crises: the COVID-19 pandemic, energy security challenges following Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and climate change. The dataset includes tweet metadata, sentiment annotations, named entities, hashtags, and user interactions.
